description: This file defines a class for rendering an asterisk marker in a PEAR PHP graphing library, extending a base marker class and implementing a method to draw the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Asterisk
classes.description: A class representing an asterisk marker for graph plotting, extending the base marker class and implementing custom drawing logic.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws an asterisk shape on the canvas at specified (x, y) coordinates.
